-- task: ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d
-- doc: 入围但无候选的原因拆解，按注册日写入 paimon
-- params: DT, OUT_DB

-- 口径与现网一致：入围是 iOS + 自然渠道 + uid 非空 + attribution_flag=1。
-- 只统计入围且结果表没有有效候选的注册。五类原因互斥。
-- 注册读 paimon.dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2_r。
-- 结果读 paimon.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d，分区 dt 是日期。
-- 落地页读 click / view 实时表，窗口是业务日前一天到业务日。
-- 分区独立覆盖，同一天重跑结果一致。

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone = Asia/Shanghai;

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d
PARTITION (dt = '${DT}') (
    app_id,
    reason_code,
    reason_name,
    register_cnt,
    etl_batch_id,
    updated_at
)
WITH elig AS (
    SELECT
        r.dt,
        r.app_id,
        r.uid,
        r.event_id AS register_event_id,
        r.event_time AS register_event_time,
        r.ip AS reg_ip
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2_r r
    WHERE r.dt = '${DT}'
      AND (
            LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, ''))) IN ('organic', 'natural', 'self')
         OR TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, '')) = ''
      )
      AND r.uid IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(r.device)) = 'ios'
      AND r.attribution_flag = 1
),
has_cand AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(f.dt AS STRING) AS dt,
        f.app_id,
        f.uid,
        f.register_event_id
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d f
    WHERE f.dt = CAST('${DT}' AS DATE)
      AND f.source_event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(f.source_event_id) <> ''
),
no_cand AS (
    SELECT
        e.dt,
        e.app_id,
        e.uid,
        e.register_event_id,
        e.register_event_time,
        e.reg_ip
    FROM elig e
    LEFT JOIN has_cand c
        ON  e.dt = c.dt
        AND e.app_id = c.app_id
        AND e.uid = c.uid
        AND e.register_event_id = c.register_event_id
    WHERE c.register_event_id IS NULL
),
lp AS (
    SELECT app_id, ip, channel, event_time
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_landing_page_click_d_r
    WHERE dt IN ('${DT-1}', '${DT}')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT app_id, ip, channel, event_time
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_landing_page_view_d_r
    WHERE dt IN ('${DT-1}', '${DT}')
),
flags AS (
    SELECT
        n.dt,
        n.app_id,
        n.register_event_id,
        n.reg_ip,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.ip IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_any_lp,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN l.ip IS NOT NULL
                 AND l.channel IS NOT NULL
                 AND TRIM(l.channel) <> ''
                 AND LOWER(TRIM(l.channel)) <> 'organic'
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS has_paid_lp,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN l.ip IS NOT NULL
                 AND l.channel IS NOT NULL
                 AND TRIM(l.channel) <> ''
                 AND LOWER(TRIM(l.channel)) <> 'organic'
                 AND l.event_time < n.register_event_time
                 AND unix_timestamp(n.register_event_time) - unix_timestamp(l.event_time) <= 86400
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS has_window_lp
    FROM no_cand n
    LEFT JOIN lp l
        ON  n.app_id = l.app_id
        AND n.reg_ip IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(n.reg_ip) <> ''
        AND n.reg_ip = l.ip
    GROUP BY n.dt, n.app_id, n.register_event_id, n.reg_ip
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        dt,
        app_id,
        CASE
            WHEN reg_ip IS NULL OR TRIM(reg_ip) = '' THEN 'reg_ip_empty'
            WHEN has_any_lp = 0 THEN 'no_landing_same_ip'
            WHEN has_paid_lp = 0 THEN 'landing_channel_organic_or_empty'
            WHEN has_window_lp = 0 THEN 'time_not_met'
            ELSE 'uncategorized'
        END AS reason_code
    FROM flags
)
SELECT
    app_id,
    reason_code,
    CASE reason_code
        WHEN 'reg_ip_empty' THEN '注册IP为空。'
        WHEN 'no_landing_same_ip' THEN '无同 app、同 IP 的 click 或 view 落地页。'
        WHEN 'landing_channel_organic_or_empty' THEN '存在同 app、同 IP 落地页，但 channel 均为空或 organic。'
        WHEN 'time_not_met' THEN '存在非自然渠道落地页，但均不满足早于注册且时间差不超过24小时。'
        WHEN 'uncategorized' THEN '未归类：无法归入前四类。'
        ELSE reason_code
    END AS reason_name,
    COUNT(*) AS register_cnt,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS etl_batch_id,
    current_timestamp() AS updated_at
FROM classified
GROUP BY app_id, reason_code;

-- 无候选原因 Paimon 表。计算脚本里不写建表。
-- ${OUT_DB} 测试渲染成 test，生产渲染成 paimon。
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d (
    app_id         STRING,
    reason_code    STRING,
    reason_name    STRING,
    register_cnt   BIGINT,
    etl_batch_id   STRING,
    updated_at     TIMESTAMP,
    dt             STRING
)
USING paimon
PARTITIONED BY (dt);

-- task: pb_ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d
-- doc: 无候选原因从 paimon 回写 StarRocks 影子表
-- params: DT, DTC

SET new_planner_optimize_timeout = 60000;
-- 回写影子表。正式表仍由海豚写入。
INSERT OVERWRITE ads.ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d_paimon_shadow PARTITION (p${DTC}) (
    dt,
    app_id,
    reason_code,
    reason_name,
    register_cnt,
    etl_batch_id,
    updated_at
)
SELECT
    CAST(dt AS DATE),
    app_id,
    reason_code,
    reason_name,
    register_cnt,
    etl_batch_id,
    updated_at
FROM paimon.ads.ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d
WHERE dt = '${DT}';

# 设计：【归因无候选】ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d · 又初

> stage 2 / 7 — 设计

## 方案概述

按现网口径重算入围但无候选的原因拆解，写入 Paimon，再回写 StarRocks 影子表。正式表继续由海豚写。

入围条件不变：iOS、自然渠道（organic / natural / self 或空）、uid 非空、`attribution_flag = 1`。有有效 `source_event_id` 的注册不算无候选。落地页探测窗是业务日前一天到业务日，click 与 view 一起看。原因五类互斥，名称与现网固定映射。

## 幂等性

分区独立。每天 `INSERT OVERWRITE` 自己的 `dt` 分区，不读自己的历史。同一天重跑覆盖，不翻倍。

## DDL 改动

Paimon 新建 `ads.ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d`，按 `dt` 分区。

StarRocks 影子表照现网 `ads.ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d` 的 `SHOW CREATE TABLE` 抄，只改表名为 `ads.ads_register_attribution_no_candidate_reason_d_d_paimon_shadow`。分区从 2026-09-01 抄到 2026-10-22。

## ETL 设计

- 注册：`paimon.dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2_r`，分区 `dt` 是字符串，等于业务日。
- 结果：`paimon.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d`，分区 `dt` 是日期。关联前把结果侧 `dt` 转成字符串。关联键是 `dt + app_id + uid + register_event_id`。
- 落地页：`paimon.dwd.dwd_landing_page_click_d_r`、`paimon.dwd.dwd_landing_page_view_d_r`，分区 `dt` 是字符串，取业务日前一天和业务日两天。时间差用秒级时间戳相减，对应现网的秒差不超过 86400 且早于注册。
- 不读用户快照。这张表不按人补维。

## 调度设计

| 项 | 取值 |
|---|---|
| 线 | 新建线 `attr_no_candidate` |
| 放行钩子 | 探 `dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2_r`、`dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d`、`dwd.dwd_landing_page_click_d_r`、`dwd.dwd_landing_page_view_d_r`，`rule=watermark`，`marginSec=60` |
| 槽位 | `04`。该槽峰值余量约 1725 秒 |
| 粒度 | day |
| 回写 SR | 要。回写步紧跟计算步 |
| 运行方式 | 分区独立 |
| 没选的候选 | 不加入 `g_day_close_all`。结果表在该线第 11 步，但这条线只跑 00 槽，00 槽峰值已经到 107.7%（编排版本 58，2026-10-19），再加步会把整条日界线拖晚。不并进归因看板线：无候选不读看板，两条可以并行 |


EXPLAIN WITH elig AS (
    SELECT r.dt, r.app_id, r.uid, r.event_id AS register_event_id, r.event_time AS register_event_time, r.ip AS reg_ip
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2_r r
    WHERE r.dt = '2026-10-18'
      AND (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, ''))) IN ('organic', 'natural', 'self') OR TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, '')) = '')
      AND r.uid IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(r.device)) = 'ios' AND r.attribution_flag = 1
),
has_cand AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(f.dt AS STRING) AS dt, f.app_id, f.uid, f.register_event_id
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d f
    WHERE f.dt = CAST('2026-10-18' AS DATE) AND f.source_event_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.source_event_id) <> ''
),
no_cand AS (
    SELECT e.dt, e.app_id, e.uid, e.register_event_id, e.register_event_time, e.reg_ip
    FROM elig e
    LEFT JOIN has_cand c ON e.dt = c.dt AND e.app_id = c.app_id AND e.uid = c.uid AND e.register_event_id = c.register_event_id
    WHERE c.register_event_id IS NULL
),
lp AS (
    SELECT app_id, ip, channel, event_time FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_landing_page_click_d_r WHERE dt IN ('2026-10-17', '2026-10-18')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT app_id, ip, channel, event_time FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_landing_page_view_d_r WHERE dt IN ('2026-10-17', '2026-10-18')
),
flags AS (
    SELECT n.dt, n.app_id, n.register_event_id, n.reg_ip,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.ip IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_any_lp,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.ip IS NOT NULL AND l.channel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.channel) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(l.channel)) <> 'organic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_paid_lp,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.ip IS NOT NULL AND l.channel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.channel) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(l.channel)) <> 'organic' AND l.event_time < n.register_event_time AND unix_timestamp(n.register_event_time) - unix_timestamp(l.event_time) <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_window_lp
    FROM no_cand n
    LEFT JOIN lp l ON n.app_id = l.app_id AND n.reg_ip IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(n.reg_ip) <> '' AND n.reg_ip = l.ip
    GROUP BY n.dt, n.app_id, n.register_event_id, n.reg_ip
),
classified AS (
    SELECT dt, app_id,
        CASE WHEN reg_ip IS NULL OR TRIM(reg_ip) = '' THEN 'reg_ip_empty' WHEN has_any_lp = 0 THEN 'no_landing_same_ip' WHEN has_paid_lp = 0 THEN 'landing_channel_organic_or_empty' WHEN has_window_lp = 0 THEN 'time_not_met' ELSE 'uncategorized' END AS reason_code
    FROM flags
)
SELECT app_id, reason_code, COUNT(*) AS register_cnt FROM classified GROUP BY app_id, reason_code

-- task: ads_action_page_funnel_d
-- doc: 页面浏览按应用、用户类型、页面汇总 PV、UV 和占比
-- params: DT, OUT_DB

-- 口径与现网一致。只读页面浏览实时表。分区独立覆盖。

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone = Asia/Shanghai;

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_action_page_funnel_d
PARTITION (dt = '${DT}') (
    app_id,
    user_type,
    event,
    page_key,
    page_name,
    page_pv,
    page_uv,
    app_uv,
    app_pv,
    pv_ratio,
    uv_ratio
)
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        uid,
        page_key,
        page_name,
        CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(user_type)) = 'VIP' THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS user_type
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
    WHERE dt = '${DT}'
),
page_stat AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        user_type,
        page_key,
        'view' AS event,
        substring(MAX(page_name), 1, 512) AS page_name,
        COUNT(1) AS page_pv,
        COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS page_uv
    FROM src
    WHERE app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id <> ''
      AND page_key IS NOT NULL AND page_key <> ''
    GROUP BY app_id, user_type, page_key
),
app_total_stat AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        user_type,
        COUNT(1) AS total_app_pv,
        COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS total_app_uv
    FROM src
    GROUP BY app_id, user_type
)
SELECT
    p.app_id,
    p.user_type,
    p.event,
    p.page_key,
    p.page_name,
    p.page_pv,
    p.page_uv,
    a.total_app_uv AS app_uv,
    a.total_app_pv AS app_pv,
    ROUND(p.page_pv * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.total_app_pv, 0), 4) AS pv_ratio,
    ROUND(p.page_uv * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.total_app_uv, 0), 4) AS uv_ratio
FROM page_stat p
LEFT JOIN app_total_stat a
    ON p.app_id = a.app_id AND p.user_type = a.user_type;

-- 行为页漏斗 Paimon 表。计算脚本里不写建表。
-- OUT_DB 测试渲染成 test，生产渲染成 paimon。
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_action_page_funnel_d (
    app_id      STRING,
    user_type   STRING,
    event       STRING,
    page_key    STRING,
    page_name   STRING,
    page_pv     BIGINT,
    page_uv     BIGINT,
    app_uv      BIGINT,
    app_pv      BIGINT,
    pv_ratio    DOUBLE,
    uv_ratio    DOUBLE,
    dt          STRING
)
USING paimon
PARTITIONED BY (dt);

-- task: pb_ads_action_page_funnel_d
-- doc: 行为页漏斗从 paimon 回写 StarRocks 影子表
-- params: DT, DTC

SET new_planner_optimize_timeout = 60000;
-- 回写影子表。正式表仍由海豚写入。
INSERT OVERWRITE ads.ads_action_page_funnel_d_paimon_shadow PARTITION (p${DTC}) (
    dt,
    app_id,
    user_type,
    event,
    page_key,
    page_name,
    page_pv,
    page_uv,
    app_uv,
    app_pv,
    pv_ratio,
    uv_ratio
)
SELECT
    CAST(dt AS DATE),
    app_id,
    user_type,
    event,
    page_key,
    page_name,
    page_pv,
    page_uv,
    app_uv,
    app_pv,
    pv_ratio,
    uv_ratio
FROM paimon.ads.ads_action_page_funnel_d
WHERE dt = '${DT}';

-- task: ads_page_heatmap_d
-- doc: 页面点击按网格汇总次数和占比
-- params: DT, OUT_DB

-- 口径与现网一致。只读页面点击实时表。分区独立覆盖。

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone = Asia/Shanghai;

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_page_heatmap_d
PARTITION (dt = '${DT}') (
    page_key,
    app_id,
    x,
    y,
    page_name,
    click_cnt,
    click_ratio,
    max_x,
    max_y
)
WITH base_aggregation AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        page_key,
        CAST(ROUND(CAST(click_x_percent AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) AS x,
        CAST(ROUND(CAST(click_y_percent AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT) AS y,
        substring(MAX(page_name), 1, 512) AS page_name,
        COUNT(1) AS click_cnt,
        CAST(100 AS BIGINT) AS max_x,
        CAST(100 AS BIGINT) AS max_y
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_click_d_r
    WHERE dt = '${DT}'
      AND click_x_percent IS NOT NULL
      AND click_y_percent IS NOT NULL
      AND app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id <> ''
      AND page_key IS NOT NULL AND page_key <> ''
    GROUP BY
        app_id,
        page_key,
        CAST(ROUND(CAST(click_x_percent AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT),
        CAST(ROUND(CAST(click_y_percent AS DOUBLE)) AS BIGINT)
)
SELECT
    page_key,
    app_id,
    x,
    y,
    page_name,
    click_cnt,
    ROUND(click_cnt * 100.0 / SUM(click_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, page_key), 4) AS click_ratio,
    max_x,
    max_y
FROM base_aggregation;

-- 页面热力 Paimon 表。计算脚本里不写建表。
-- OUT_DB 测试渲染成 test，生产渲染成 paimon。
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_page_heatmap_d (
    page_key    STRING,
    app_id      STRING,
    x           BIGINT,
    y           BIGINT,
    page_name   STRING,
    click_cnt   BIGINT,
    click_ratio DOUBLE,
    max_x       BIGINT,
    max_y       BIGINT,
    dt          STRING
)
USING paimon
PARTITIONED BY (dt);

-- task: pb_ads_page_heatmap_d
-- doc: 页面热力从 paimon 回写 StarRocks 影子表
-- params: DT, DTC

SET new_planner_optimize_timeout = 60000;
-- 回写影子表。正式表仍由海豚写入。
INSERT OVERWRITE ads.ads_page_heatmap_d_paimon_shadow PARTITION (p${DTC}) (
    dt,
    page_key,
    app_id,
    x,
    y,
    page_name,
    click_cnt,
    click_ratio,
    max_x,
    max_y
)
SELECT
    CAST(dt AS DATE),
    page_key,
    app_id,
    x,
    y,
    page_name,
    click_cnt,
    click_ratio,
    max_x,
    max_y
FROM paimon.ads.ads_page_heatmap_d
WHERE dt = '${DT}';

)
